name: Opportunist
description: Once per round, you can reroll your plot die

name: Watchful Eye
description: Use Opportunist on the plot die of a willing ally within 20 ft

name: Get 'Em Talking
description: Spend 1 focus to test Deduction vs. Spiritual to learn the target's motivation. During this scene, you can raise the stakes on tests to leverage this motivation

name: Quick Analysis
description: Spend 2 focus to gain 2 actions for Cognitive tests with Use a Skill, Gain Advantage, or an Agent talent.

name: Baleful
description: To resist your influence, a character must spend additional focus equal to your tier.

name: Gather Evidence
description: Gain Legal Codes expertise. When you succeed on a cognitive test against a target, you become Focused.

name: Hardy
description: Gain +1 max health per level (including previous levels).

name: Sleuth's Instincts
description: Gain an advantage on cognitive tests against characters whose motivation you know. You know when those characters lie to you.

name: Close the Case
description: Spend 3 focus to test Deduction vs. Cognitive, gaining an advantage if you know the target's motivation. On failure, the target gains an advantage against you. On success, they back down.

name: Sure Outcome
description: When you use Opportunist, spend 2 focus to change Opportunity to Complication 4, or any Complication to Opportunity.

name: Plausible Excuse
description: Gain Sleight of Hand expertise. When discovered skulking, spend 2 focus to feign innocence.

name: Collected
description: Increase your Cognitive and Spiritual defenses by 2.

name: Cover Story
description: Gain a false identity and a relevant culture expertise.

name: Subtle Takedown
description: Make an unarmed attack with Insight vs. an unsuspecting target's Cognitive, raising the stakes. On a hit, they can't communicate.

name: Mighty
description: When you hit with a weapon or unarmed attack, for each action spent, deal extra damage equal to 1 + your tier.

name: Mercurial Façade
description: Disguise yourself using Deception without needing physical supplies. The first character to see through your disguise is Surprised.

name: High Society Contacts
prerequisites: Cover Story; Patron in high society
description: Gain High Society expertise. Spend 2 focus to add Opportunity to a test to interact in high society.

name: Risky Behavior
description: Spend 1 focus to raise the stakes on your test.

name: Cheap Shot
description: Spend 1 focus to make an unarmed attack with Thievery vs. Cognitive, raising the stakes. On a hit, the target is Stunned.

name: Double Down
description: You can reroll again with Opportunist, but on Complication, you lose 2 focus.

name: Surefooted
description: Your movement increases by 10. Reduce damage from falling and dangerous terrain by twice your tier.

name: Underworld Contacts
prerequisites: Double Down; Patron or follower in criminal underworld
description: Gain Criminal Groups expertise. Spend 2 focus to add Opportunity to a social test against criminals.

name: Shadow Step
description: After you Disengage, spend 2 focus to test Thievery vs. each enemy's Cognitive to hide from them. You gain an advantage if in cover or obscured.

name: Fast Talker
description: Spend 2 focus to gain 2 actions for Spiritual tests with Use a Skill, Gain Advantage, or an Agent talent.

name: Trickster's Hand
description: Spend 2 focus to gain 2 actions for Physical tests with Use a Skill, Gain Advantage, or an Agent Talent.

name: Rousing Presence
description: An ally becomes Determined until end of scene.

name: Steadfast Challenge
description: Spend 1 focus to test Discipline vs. an enemy's Spiritual. On success, they are Disoriented and gain a disadvantage on tests against you.

name: Collected
description: Increase your Cognitive and Spiritual defenses by 2.

name: Withering Retort
description: Use your Steadfast Challenge before an attack and increase your deflect against the attack by your ranks in Discipline.

name: Well Dressed
description: Gain Fashion expertise. While wearing Presentable armor or fashionable clothing, gain an advantage on your first Deception, Leadership, or Persuasion test.

name: Calm Appeal
description: When your Steadfast Challenge makes a target Disoriented, spend 1 focus to pacify them. Resisting your Steadfast Challenge costs additional focus equal to your ranks in Discipline.

name: High Society Contacts
prerequisites: Well Dressed; Patron in high society
description: Gain High Society expertise. Spend 2 focus to add Opportunity to a test to interact in high society.

name: Peaceful Solution
description: If all non-minion enemies are pacified, you ase tensions and end combat.

name: Practiced Oratory
description: When you use Rousing Resence or Steadfast Challenge, spend focus up to your ranks in Persuasion to add that many targets.

name: Customary Garb
description: While wearing Prsentable armor or appropriate clothing, increase your Physical and Spriritual defenses by 2.

name: Galvanize
description: An ally rolls their recovery die and recovers that much focus.

name: Devoted Presence
description: When you use Rousing Presence, spend 1 focus to remove Prone, Slowed, Stunned, and Surprised from your target

name: Composed
description: Increase your max and current focus by your tier.

name: Stalwart Presence
description: When you use Rousing Presence, spend 1 focus to increase one of the target's defenses by 2.

name: Applied Motivation
description: When you cause a character to recover focus, they recover additional focus equal to half your ranks in Lore.

name: Sage Counsel
description: When you Aid a character, spend 1 focus to grant them Rousing Presence.

name: Inspired Zeal
description: When an ally uses Determined, choose other allies to recover 1 focus, up to your ranks in Discipline

name: Sound Advice
description: Spend 1 focus to use Rousing Presence on an ally who failed a skill test.

name: Practical Demonstration
description: When you Gain Advantage or hit with an attack, use your Rousing Presence as a Free Action.

name: Lessons in Patience
description: Gain Motivational Speech expertise. When you use Rousing Presence, your target recoveres 1 focus.

name: Mighty
description: When you hit with a weapon or unarmed attack, for each action spent, deal extra damage equal to 1 + your tier.

name: Instill Confidence
description: Rousing Presence can make an ally Focused instead of Determined.

name: Guiding Oration
description: After you Gain Advantage, an ally within 10 ft of your target gains an advantage on their next test against your target.

name: Foresight
description: Gain an additional reaction each turn.

name: Rallying Shout
description: Rousing Presence can revive an Unconcious ally, and if they have 0 health, they recover health equal to their recovery die + your ranks in Leadership.

name: Seek Quarry
description: Choose a character to be your quarry, gaining an advantage on tests to find, attack, and study them.

name: Tagging Shot
description: Move 5 ft and make a ranged attack. On a hit or a graze, the target becomes your quarry.

name: Combat Training
description: Gain expertise in a weapon, an armor, and Military Life. Once per round, graze without spending focus.

name: Sharp Eye
description: Observe a target then test Perception vs. Cognitive to learn their lowest attribute, lowest defense, or if their health, focus, or Investiture are below half.

name: Steady Aim
description: Increase your weapon range by half and deal extra damage equal to your ranks in Perception.

name: Exploit Weakness
description: Gain Advantage on your quarry without spending an action.

name: Backstep
description: After making a ranged attack, spend 2 focus to Disengage without spending an action, and Brace if you enter cover or obscured area.

name: Unrelenting Salvo
description: You can Strike your quarry more than once per turn with the same ranged weapon.

name: Hardy
description: Gain +1 max health per level (including previous levels).

name: Startling Blow
description: Make an unarmed or improvised weapon attack vs. Cognitive. On a hit or graze, the target is Surprised.

name: Killing Edge
description: Gain Knives and Slings expertises. These weapons gain the Deadly and Quickdraw expert traits.

name: Fatal Thrust
description: Attack an unsuspecting target with a light melee weapon vs. Cognitive. Add 4d4 damage, and gain two advantages if the weapon is Discreet. Max damage rolls add a penalty to the injury roll.

name: Shadowing
description: Your quarry gains a disadvantage to sense you, and you gain an advantage to avoid their notice. When you succeed vs. Spiritual while in cover or obscured, spend 3 focus to designate that target as your quarry.

name: Mighty
description: When you hit with a weapon or unarmed attack, for each action spent, deal extra damage equal to 1 + your tier.

name: Cold Eyes
description: After you defeat your quarry, recover 1 focus and choose a new quarry.

name: Swift Strikes
description: Spend 1 focus to make a second Strike with the same weapon.

name: Sidestep
description: Gain an additional reaction to Dodge when you're not wearing armor with deflect of 2 or higher.

name: Deadly Trap
description: Conceal a 5 ft entangling or impaling trap. Entangling Trap: Test Survival vs. Cognitive, roll 2d4 impact damage. Target is Immobilized and the area becomes difficult terrain. Impaling Trap: Test Survival vs. Physical, roll 2d4 keen damage. Target is Afflicted [vital damage equal to 3 + your ranks in Survival].

name: Animal Bond
description: While your companion is within 10 ft, your defenses increase by 1. Use a Free Action to give your companion one or two Actions on your turn. They can use Track for 2 Actions: One target within your companion's reach becoems your quarry.

name: Experienced Trapper
description: You easily forage for characters up to your ranks in Survival. You can fashion natural tools using Survival. Your Deadly Traps increase to 2d6 damage and 2 rounds duration.

name: Protective Bond
description: Your animal companion protects an ally within 30 ft of you, and that ally gains your Animal Bond bonus instead of you.

name: Surefooted
description: Your movement increases by 10. Reduce damage from falling and dangerous terrain by twice your tier.

name: Feral Connection
description: Gain expertise in Animal Care. Your animal companion's health increases by 5 x your tier, and their defenses increase by 2, and their tests gain a bonus equal to your ranks in Survival.

name: Hunter's Edge
description: Your animal companion gains an advantage against your quarry. Your Deadly Traps increase to 2d8 damage and 3 rounds duration.

name: Pack Hunting
description: Spend 1 focus to add your ranks in Survival to your ally's attack or damage roll against your quarry.

name: Decisive Command
description: Spend 1 focus to give an ally within 20 ft a d4 command die. They can add it to one die roll on their next test.

name: Combat Coordination
description: After you Strike, use Decisive Command without spending an action. If your Strike didn't hit, you also don't spend focus.

name: Valiant Intervention
description: Spend 1 focus to move 10 ft, then test Athletics vs. Spiritual to give a target disadvantage on tests against your allies.

name: Imposing Posture
description: After an enemy resists your influence while in your weapon's reach, they are Disoriented.

name: Hardy
description: Gain +1 max health per level (including previous levels).

name: Mighty
description: When you hit with a weapon or unarmed attack, for each action spent, deal extra damage equal to 1 + your tier.

name: Resolute Stand
description: Valiant Intervention prevents Reactive Strikes. Spend focus up to your ranks in Leadership to add that many targets for Valiant Intervention.

name: Resilient Hero
description: Before your health drops to 0, it instead becomes equal to your Athletics modifier

name: Demonstrative Command
description: Increase the size of your command die. Spend 1 focus to add your command die to your Athletic, Agility, or Leadership d20 roll.

name: Focused Mind
description: Increase your max and current focus by your tier.

name: Through the Fray
description: An ally within 20 ft can Disengage or Gain Advantage as a reaction.

name: Well Supplied
description: Gain Military Logistics expertise. Spend 2 focus to add Opportunity to your test to requisition resources.

name: Customary Garb
description: While wearing Prsentable armor or appropriate clothing, increase your Physical and Spriritual defenses by 2.

name: Relentless March
description: Decisive Command increases your target's movement by 10 feet, and they ignore Exhausted, Slowed, and Surprised.

name: Confident Command
description: Increase the size of your command die. Spend 1 focus to add your command die to your Intimidation, Leadership, or Persuasion d20 rolls.

name: Authority
prerequisites: Title granting you command of 5+ people
description: Double the range of Leader talents that affect allies, and double the number of allies affected.

name: Synchronized Assault
description: Spend 2 focus to test Leadership vs. enemy's Cognitive. On success, allies up to your ranks in Leadership gain an Action for an additional Strike against the target. On failure, only one ally gains an Action.

name: Cutthroat Tactics
description: Your ally can raise the stakes instead of rolling your command die; if they roll Complication, you recover 1 focus.

name: Tactical Ploy
description: Test Deception vs. Cognitive to make your taret lose one reaction and gain a disadvantage on their next cognitive or spiritual test.

name: Rumormonger
description: Gain Scandal expertise. Spend 2 focus to add Opportunity when you make a test to spread misinformation or gather rumors.

name: Well Dressed
description: Gain a Fashion expertise. While wearing Presentable armor or fashionable clothing, gain an advantage on your first Deception, Leadership, or Persuasion test.

name: Baleful
description: To resist your influence, a character must spend additional focus equal to your tier.

name: Set at Odds
description: Spend focus equal lto the number of targets you want to seed division among. Test Leadership vs. their highest Spiritual to make them hostile to each other.

name: Shrewd Command
description: Increase the size of your command die. Spend 1 focus to add your command die to your Deception, Insight, or Leadership d20 roll.

name: Grand Deception
description: Spend 3 focus to test Deception (DC 15) to reveal a ruse that changes a detail.

name: Erudition
description: Temporarily gain a cultural or utility expertise and a rank in two non-invested cognitive skills. Reassign these after a long rest with library access.

name: Efficient Engineer
description: Gain expertise in Armor Crafting, Equipment Crafting, or Weapon Crafting, and gain a fabrial. When crafting, your Opportunity range expands by 2 and your material cost is halved.

name: Prized Acquisition
description: Gain Fabrial Crafting expertise. Gain a special gem you can immediately use to craft a fabrial of your tier. You can reuse this gem for new fabrials.

name: Deep Study
description: Erudition grants you an additional cultural or utility expertise and two additional non-invested cognitive skills.

name: Inventive Design
description: Your Prized Acquisition fabrial can have an effect 1 tier higher than the tier you're currently crafting.

name: Fine Handiwork
description: When crafting, advanced features cost one upgrade instead of two.

name: Overcharge
description: Once per turn, you can raise the stakes on a fabrial attack, then spend Opportunity to Strike with that fabrial as a Free Action.

name: Experimental Tinkering
description: When crafting, your Opportunity range expands by 1 and your crafting time is halved. During a long rest, you can reconfigure your Prized Acquisition fabrial to a different fabrial.

name: Overwhelm with Details
description: Spend 2 focus to use your Lore modifier on another cognitive or spiritual test.

name: Strategize
description: After you Gain Advantage using an Erudition skill, grant that advantage to an ally instead. You can spend 2 focus to also prevent the target from using reactions against that ally.

name: Mind and Body
description: Gain a weapon expertise. Gain an additional skill from Erudition. You can now choose physical skills with Erudition.

name: Clear Mind
description: Increase your max and current focus by your tier.

name: Know Your Moment
description: Your defenses increase by 2 from the start of each round until you take your turn.

name: Deep Contemplation
description: Reassign up to 2 skills and expertises from Erudition

name: Keen Insight
description: After you Gain Advantage, the target must resist your influence or gain a disadvantage on their next test.

name: Contingency
description: Spend 2 focus to remove Complication from the test of an ally within 20 ft.

name: Turning Point
description: Spend 2 focus to test Deduction vs. Cognitive of the enemy leader, gaining an advantage if you took a slow turn. On a success, you and your allies gain an Action on your next turns.

name: Field Medicine
description: Spend 1 focus and test Medicine (DC 15) to heal a concious character. On success, add your ranks in Medicine to their recovery die.

name: Emotional Intelligence
description: Gain Diagnosis expertise. Gain an additional skill from Erudtition. You can now choose Spiritual skills with Erudition.

name: Anatomical Insight
description: When you hit with an unarmed attack, spend 1 focus or Opportunity to make the target Exhausted [ - half your ranks in Medicine].

name: Collected
description: Increase your Cognitive and Spiritual defenses by 2.

name: Swift Healer
description: Use Field Medicine as a Free Action. Your healing abilities restore additional health equal to your ranks in Medicine.

name: Applied Medicine
description: Your healing abilities restore additional health equal to your ranks in Lore.

name: Ongoing Care
description: Gain Mental Health Care expertise. During a rest, test Medicine (DC 10) to treat an ally, removing one condition caused by their injury.

name: Resuscitation
description: Spend 3 focus when using Field Medicine to revive an Unconcious character or one who died recently.

name: Vigilant Stance
description: Enter Vigilant Stance: Reduce the focus cost of Dodge and Reactive Strike by 1, and you can enter other stances as a Free Action.

name: Practiced Kata
description: You can now use stances in conversation and endeavors, and unless Surprised, you can start each scene in Vigilant Stance. Spend 1 focus to enter a stance mid-conversation or mid-endeavor.

name: Flamestance
description: Enter Flamestance: You gain an advantage on Intimidation, and when only one enemy is in reach and no allies are, gain an Action to attack or Gain Advantage.

name: Ironstance
description: Enter Ironstance: You gain an advantage on Insight, and when you're grazed or missed, you can make a Reactive Strike against your attacker.

name: Signature Weapon
description: Gain a weapon expertise. Choose one of your weapon expertises, expanding its Opportunity range by 1.

name: Surefooted
description: Your movement increases by 10. Reduce damage from falling and dangerous terrain by twice your tier.

name: Feinting Strike
description: Spend 2 focus to make a melee weapon attack vs. Cognitive. On a hit, your target loses Reaction and loses focus equal to your ranks in Intimidation. On a graze, they lose half as much focus.

name: Vinestance
description: Enter Vinestance: Your Physical and Cognitive defenses increase by 1. After you're hit or grazed in melee, spend Reaction to test Athletics vs. Cognitive to make attacker lsoe 1d4 focus and be pushed.

name: Wit's End
description: Spend 1 focus to move half your movement then make a melee weapon attack vs. Cognitive of a target who has 0 focus. This attack ignores deflect, deals an extra 4d6 damage, and can't graze.

name: Shard Training
prerequisites: Access to a Shardblade and Shardplate
description: Gain Shardblade expertise, and gain either Grandbow, Shardblade, or Warhammer expertise. Your Shardplate has 2 additional charges. Your Shardblade Strikes graze additional targets up to your ranks in the skill used.

name: Stonestance
description: Enter Stonestance: Your deflect increases by 1, and enemies within your reach must spend an additional Action to attack your allies who aren't in Stonestance.

name: Windstance
description: Enter Windstance: Gain an advantage on Agility. While you can reach multiple enemies, use Free Action to gain an Action to Disengage or attack.

name: Mighty
description: When you hit with a weapon or unarmed attack, for each action spent, deal extra damage equal to 1 + your tier.

name: Shattering Blow
description: When you hit with a melee attack, spend 2 focus to deplete 1 charge from their armor, and each target you damage is pushed 5 ft.

name: Bloodstance
description: Enter Bloodstance: Your Opportunity range for attacks and physical tess expands by 2, but your Physical, Cognitive, and Spiritual defenses decrease by 2.

name: Precise Parry
description: Before being hit in melee, spend 1 focus to attempt to turn it into a graze. If unarmed, test Athletics vs. triggering attack, gaining a disadvantage unless attacked by a Shardblade. If armed, test Light/Heavy Weaponry vs. triggering attack.

name: Meteoric Leap
description: Spend 2 focus to leap a quarter of your movement and make an unarmed attack vs. Physical of multiple targets, doubling damage and knocking weaker targets Prone. Gain an advantage in Shardplate.

name: Cautious Advance
description: Move up to half your movement, ignoring difficult terrain, then gain 2 Actions to Brace or Gain Advantage.

name: Combat Training
description: Gain expertise in a weapon, an armor, and Military Life. Once per round, graze without spending focus.

name: Defensive Position
description: The Brace action adds two disadvantages to attacks against you, instead of one, and allies can Brace behind your shield.

name: Devastating Blow
description: Make a melee weapon atack vs. Physical, rolling an extra 2d8 damage.

name: Formation Drills
description: Allies within 10 ft who Brace gain the benefits of your Defensive Position.

name: Hardy
description: Gain +1 max health per level (including previous levels).

name: Wary
description: You can't be Surprised while you have focus. When you lose focus involuntarily, reduce the amount lost by your ranks in Discipline.

name: Swift Strikes
description: Spend 1 focus to make a second Strike with the same weapon.
